objective: Deliver a buyer-facing Storage Waste dashboard slice for the Cost Management accelerator, surfacing orphaned tables, unused time-travel storage, and uncompressed data recommendations to enable decision-makers to prioritize storage spend reductions while ensuring existing RBAC and ELT accelerators remain unchanged and preserving sibling dataForge isolation.

journeys.name: Inspect foundational Storage Waste relational data model schemas and snapshot datasets
journeys.goal: A FinOps practitioner or Anblicks cloud cost consultant inspects the Storage Waste relational data models and snapshot schemas across canonical datasets (storage_summary, table_storage_metrics, stale_tables, uncompressed_storage, storage_usage_history, recommendation_queue), confirming typed schema definitions, storage byte measures, and governance field completeness without requiring live Snowflake account credentials.
steps: Inspect foundational Storage Waste schema definitions in docs/cost-management-storage-waste-contract.md.

Verify that all canonical relational datasets (storage_summary, table_storage_metrics, stale_tables, uncompressed_storage, storage_usage_history, recommendation_queue) define typed column structures and relationships surfacing orphaned tables, unused time-travel storage, and uncompressed data recommendations.
Confirm that recommendation_queue preserves recommendation_id, executive_severity, suggested_owner, recommended_action, evidence_detail, and guardrail fields.
Execute targeted pytest check python3 -m pytest tests/test_cost_storage_waste.py -q -k test_ac1_storage_summary_schema_and_columns from workspace root to verify schema and traceability conformance.

journeys.name: Verify Storage Waste dashboard specification structure and canonical DataAdapter runtime seams
journeys.goal: An enterprise analytics delivery lead reviews the Storage Waste dashboard specification (DashboardSpec) and runtime query wiring, confirming that headline KPI summary cards, storage volume distribution charts, table access aging visualizers, and the prioritized recommendation queue bind exclusively to standard DataAdapter interfaces without bespoke renderers.
steps: Review the Storage Waste DashboardSpec contract declaring responsive layout, KPI summary cards, storage distribution breakdown, table aging visualizers, and recommendation queue enabling decision-makers to prioritize storage spend reductions.
Verify that presentation widgets bind exclusively to canonical DataAdapter interfaces (StaticDataAdapter, SyntheticDataArtifactAdapter, SQLiteDataAdapter) without bespoke renderers.
Execute npm --prefix frontend test -- --run -t "StandaloneDashboardApp" from workspace root to confirm component rendering.
Confirm all tests pass cleanly with exit code 0.

journeys.name: Verify prioritized storage recommendations, governance fields, and directional validation guardrails
journeys.goal: A FinOps practice director verifies that the Storage Waste dashboard surfaces prioritized recommendations for stale tables and uncompressed storage with all six governance attributes, directional owner-validation guardrails, and decision-ready follow-up artifacts.
steps: Inspect the recommendation queue for prioritized storage waste actions spanning orphaned tables, unused time-travel storage, and uncompressed data recommendations.
Verify all six governance fields (recommendation_id, executive_severity, suggested_owner, recommended_action, evidence_detail, guardrail) are populated with P0 high-impact items ordered first.
Confirm all recommendations and projected savings are framed as directional pending validation by designated table owners and stewards.
Execute python3 -m pytest tests/test_cost_storage_waste.py -q -k test_ac3_recommendation_queue_governance_fields from workspace root to verify recommendation queue governance.

journeys.name: Verify persistent synthetic disclosures and production build smoke gate contract markers
journeys.goal: A release engineer verifies that the frontend production build compiled from frontend/dist preserves contract markers and satisfies browser smoke gate readiness with unsuppressed Synthetic demo data disclosures and zero live credentials.
steps: Inspect standalone dashboard presentation components for same-day executive follow-up deliverable actions and landscape PDF export capabilities.
Verify persistent unsuppressed synthetic data disclosure with exact text 'Synthetic demo data' and data-mode='real-client-disabled' with zero live credentials.
Verify browser smoke gate conformance and contract marker preservation ('storage-waste', 'synthetic-demo-data', 'open-recommendation-queue', 'recommendation-queue').
Execute python3 -m pytest tests/test_cost_storage_waste.py -q -k test_ac4_persistent_unsuppressed_synthetic_disclosure from workspace root to verify disclosure integrity.

journeys.name: Verify verbatim workspace-root execution of application CLI commands under direct argv
journeys.goal: A DevOps engineer tests dashForge application commands from the workspace root using the exact 'env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main' prefix, verifying that help and execution commands run cleanly under direct argv invocation without shell pipelines.
steps: Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main --help from workspace root.
Verify command exits with code 0 under direct argv invocation without shell variable expansion.
Confirm help text displays dashForge CLI options and generate subcommands with complete acceptance check traceability across all AC-1 through AC-6 checks and zero shell operators.

journeys.name: Verify complete test suite pass, zero regressions, and sibling repository isolation
journeys.goal: A quality assurance lead executes regression test suites with no PYTHONPATH override to confirm that existing dashboard functionality, industry packs (healthcare, financial, saas, snowflakeCost), and sibling repository dataForge remain completely intact without regressions.
steps: Execute python3 -m pytest tests/test_cost_storage_waste.py -q -k test_ac6_backwards_compatibility_existing_packs with NO PYTHONPATH override.

Confirm that existing industry packs (healthcare, financial, saas, snowflakeCost:idle-warehouse-waste), RBAC accelerators, and ELT accelerators remain completely unchanged and operational with zero regressions.
Verify fail-closed overwrite protection requiring --force and strict read-only isolation of sibling repository dataForge.
